title: How Much Rent Should Your Pondicherry Shop Earn? A Guide
description: Shop rent depends on frontage, footfall, floor and parking. How to estimate what your Puducherry shop should earn and when to raise it. Book a rent review.
h1: How much rent should your Pondicherry shop earn? A practical way to estimate
lead: There is no single rate per sq ft. Two shops on the same road can earn very different rents.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

bullets: Frontage and visibility from the road
Footfall and the type of street
Size and shape of the unit
What the neighbouring businesses are like

paras: Collect asking rents for similar shops on the same road and the next one over. Ask local brokers what actually closed, not only what was quoted. Compare with your own rent and with how long your shop would stay vacant if it was re-let.
At renewal, and through an escalation clause between renewals. See [commercial rent: are you undercharging?](/guides/commercial-rent-pondicherry-undercharging).

blocks.h: Get a figure for your shop
paras: Our [free rental audit](/free-rental-audit) compares your shop with similar ones nearby.
